name: @pipeworx/mcp-overture-places

tools.name: places_search
tools.description: Find businesses and points of interest by name and/or category near a point, inside a bbox, or within a city, in the United States and the United Kingdom (Overture Maps places). Returns each place with name, category, confidence score, street address, websites, phones, emails, social links, brand and source record ids, nearest or best match first. Answers "where is the nearest Starbucks to these coordinates", "find dentists in Austin TX", "list Pret A Manger shops in London".

name.description: Business name or words in it, e.g. "Starbucks" or "Pret A Manger". Optional when category is given.

near.description: Centre point {lat, lon} in decimal degrees. Use with radius_m.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around near (50–50000).

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees, as an alternative to near.

city.description: City / town / locality name, e.g. "Austin" or "London". Needs country.

region.description: Optional state or region to disambiguate city, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

country.description: Country for city: "US" or "GB" (also accepts "UK", "United States", "United Kingdom").

category.description: Overture category, e.g. "coffee_shop", "dentist", "hotel", "restaurant", "pharmacy". Matches the basic category, the taxonomy primary or any level of its hierarchy.

min_confidence.description: Hide places whose Overture existence confidence is below this (0–1). Default 0.7.

include_closed.description: Include places Overture marks permanently_closed. Default false.

tools.name: places_by_domain
tools.description: List every physical location whose website is on a company domain — the store / office / branch footprint of a business — in the United States and the United Kingdom (Overture Maps places). Give a domain like "starbucks.com" or a full URL; subdomains and paths fold to the registrable domain. Returns the total count, counts by country and by state/region, and the locations with addresses, phones and confidence. Answers "how many locations does acme.com have and where".

domain.description: Company domain or website URL, e.g. "starbucks.com", "https://www.tesco.com/stores".

country.description: Optional: only locations in this country ("US" or "GB").

region.description: Optional: only locations in this state/region, e.g. "TX".

min_confidence.description: Hide places whose Overture existence confidence is below this (0–1). Default 0.7.

include_closed.description: Include places Overture marks permanently_closed. Default false.

limit.description: Max locations returned (1–1000, default 100). Counts always cover all matches.

tools.name: places_in_area
tools.description: Count and list the businesses and points of interest inside an area — a bbox, a radius around a point, or a whole city — in the United States and the United Kingdom (Overture Maps places), optionally for one category. Returns the total, a breakdown by category, and the highest-confidence places. Answers "how many restaurants are in this bbox", "what kinds of businesses are within 500 m of this address", "how many gyms are in Manchester".

near.description: Centre point {lat, lon} in decimal degrees. Use with radius_m.

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around near (50–50000).

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees, as an alternative to near.

city.description: City / town / locality name, e.g. "Austin" or "London". Needs country.

region.description: Optional state or region to disambiguate city, e.g. "TX" or "Texas".

country.description: Country for city: "US" or "GB" (also accepts "UK", "United States", "United Kingdom").

category.description: Overture category, e.g. "coffee_shop", "dentist", "hotel", "restaurant", "pharmacy". Matches the basic category, the taxonomy primary or any level of its hierarchy.

min_confidence.description: Hide places whose Overture existence confidence is below this (0–1). Default 0.7.

include_closed.description: Include places Overture marks permanently_closed. Default false.

limit.description: Max places listed (0–200, default 25). Counts cover the whole area.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-overture-places forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the overture-places pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
